name: Veal Parmigiana
description: Crispy breaded veal cutlets topped with a homemade quick tomato sauce and melted mozzarella cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1½ lb veal cutlets, ¼ inch thick
1 egg, beaten slightly with 2 to 3 tsp milk
¾ cup sifted dry bread crumbs
¾ cup fresh grated Parmesan cheese
½ to ¾ cup butter for frying
1 large can (16 oz) Italian crushed tomatoes
1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese for topping

recipeInstructions.text: Prepare breading station: In one bowl, mix egg and milk. In another, combine bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese.
Pound veal cutlets until thin, then coat in flour, dip in egg mixture, and finally coat with bread crumb mixture. Let sit for 15 minutes.
Melt butter in a frying pan and sauté veal over low heat until cooked through, flipping carefully.
Combine crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, onion, sugar, and salt in a pot. Bring to a boil, then simmer gently for 15 to 20 minutes to make the quick tomato sauce.
Place cooked veal in a baking pan, pour tomato sauce over the top, and sprinkle with shredded mozzarella cheese.
Bake in a preheated 400°F oven until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

keywords: veal parmesan, breaded veal, Italian-American, tomato sauce

_similar.name: Parmesan Chicken
_similar.description: A crispy Parmesan-crusted chicken dish baked with spaghetti sauce and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix Parmesan cheese with bread crumbs and set aside.
Mix eggs, salt, and pepper.
Dip boneless chicken breasts in egg mixture, then coat with bread crumb mixture.
Arrange coated chicken breasts in a baking dish.
Cover with tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Pour spaghetti sauce over the chicken and continue baking.
Before serving, sprinkle grated mozzarella cheese on top and bake for an additional 10 minutes until browned.

_similar.keywords: Parmesan chicken, breaded chicken, Italian-American cuisine

_similar.name: Jelly Roll Style Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A creative meat loaf recipe shaped like a jelly roll, filled with mozzarella cheese and baked in a loaf pan.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup cracker crumbs or dry bread crumbs

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients except ground beef in a large bowl, using only 1 cup of mozzarella cheese.
Add ground beef and mix thoroughly with hands until just combined.
Shape the mixture into a 10x12 inch rectangle on waxed paper.
Sprinkle 2 cups of mozzarella cheese over the meat.
Roll up the mixture like a jelly roll using the waxed paper and press ends together to seal.
Place the foil-wrapped jelly roll in a meat loaf pan and bake in a 350°F oven for 1 hour.
Drain off fat and pour reserved tomato sauce on the roll.
Bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before slicing.
Decorate with tomato slices and green parsley on a serving tray.

_similar.keywords: meat loaf, jelly roll, mozzarella cheese, baked

_similar.name: Meatball Pasta Stew
_similar.description: A savory stew with homemade meatballs, pasta, and a rich tomato-based sauce.
recipeIngredient: ¼ to ⅛ cup dry bread crumbs

recipeInstructions.text: Combine hamburger, egg, bread crumbs, onion, salt, mustard, and pepper to make meatballs. Shape into 1-inch balls.
Place meatballs on a greased baking sheet and bake at 350°F for 10 to 15 minutes, or until browned.
In a large pot, cook onion and garlic until tender.
Add flour and stir constantly for 1 minute.
Gradually add beef broth, stirring constantly until boiling.
Add tomato paste, undrained tomatoes, bay leaf, and thyme. Mix well.
Add meatballs, carrots, zucchini, peppers, and parsley. Simmer for 40 minutes.
Add cooked pasta and heat until hot.
Remove bay leaf before serving.

_similar.keywords: meatball stew, pasta stew, tomato-based sauce

_similar.name: Cheese & Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli and cheese soup with a rich, velvety texture.

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan.
Cook onions until tender; do not brown.
Add chicken stock and broccoli; bring to a boil.
Whisk in flour and cook for 3 minutes.
Return to heat; cook and stir until mixture thickens.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes; do not boil.
Puree mixture until smooth.
Heat through with milk, cheese, and seasonings.

_similar.keywords: broccoli soup, cheese soup, creamy soup

_similar.name: Hawaiian Meatballs
_similar.description: A Hawaiian-inspired meatball recipe with a sweet and sour sauce, cooked in a pan and finished in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the meat mixture together and shape into balls.
Dredge the meatballs in flour and brown in shortening on both sides.
Remove the meatballs from the pan and set aside.
Mix the dry sauce ingredients well, then stir in the wet ingredients.
Stir the sauce mixture into the fat in the pan and cook until thick and bubbly.
Return the meatballs to the pan, cover, and put in the oven to cook for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: Hawaiian meatballs, sweet and sour sauce, oven-finished
